title: Understanding Dendrograms
text: A dendrogram is a tree-like diagram that records the sequences of merges or splits in hierarchical clustering. Can you think about how this might visually represent the clustering process?

title: Hierarchical Agglomerative Clustering
text: In hierarchical agglomerative clustering, we start with each point as its own cluster and then merge the closest pairs of clusters step by step. How might this process be represented in a dendrogram?
